source_supported_mechanisms: selectively load one or two task-relevant performance references instead of the whole corpus
evaluate skill/method use with matched with-skill versus without-skill assertions plus timing
separate TTFT, TPOT/ITL, end-to-end latency, token/request throughput, goodput and tail latency while controlling workload shape

current_f2_surfaces.finding: METHOD is already a first-class caller-declared typed memory kind with exact lifecycle generation, payload digest, provenance refs and method-specific ref tags; it is explicitly not fact or transfer authority.

Process distillation already freezes explicit process evidence into bounded deterministic process-pattern candidates and refuses to infer method validity, transfer applicability, causality, truth, effects or completion.

Matched BASELINE/INTERVENTION processing-credit evaluation already exists at repository-hosted component-CI scope. Pair identity, experiment generation, metric schema, METHOD/PROCESS identity, evidence and provenance are fenced; improvement is only a credit candidate, never causal proof.

ContextCompiler already contains CHANNEL_METHOD and deterministically selects reference-only ContextItems under caller-supplied allowed/required channels, max_items, max_cost_units, priority and exact source/provenance/generation metadata. It does not inspect payload bytes or infer relevance/truth.
The accepted epistemic adapter establishes the preferred boundary pattern: exact typed input maps into a ContextItem without semantic decoding or new truth/retrieval/scheduling authority.

architecture_mapping.method_storage: Represent imported/distilled performance procedures only through existing METHOD typed-memory/lifecycle authority. Preserve upstream repo, commit/version, payload digest, provenance, transfer conditions, falsifiers and stale/retired lifecycle state. Never convert guidance into FACT solely because it came from an upstream skill corpus.
architecture_mapping.context_routing: Expose eligible METHOD records to the existing ContextCompiler as CHANNEL_METHOD ContextItems. Use existing max_items/max_cost_units/priority/required-channel controls to realize bounded selective loading. Do not add a second semantic router inside or beside ContextCompiler.
architecture_mapping.semantic_selection_boundary: If task semantics are used to nominate candidate methods, that nomination must remain an upstream retrieval/candidate operation with explicit evidence/provenance. ContextCompiler itself remains deterministic and metadata-only.
architecture_mapping.paired_ablation: Map with-skill/without-skill to existing WP305 BASELINE/INTERVENTION matched pairs over the same fixed task identity/generation and metric schema. Each metric is a separate processing outcome/credit candidate; no aggregate improvement may mint causal or method-validity authority.
architecture_mapping.performance_characterization: Use upstream metric taxonomy only as a candidate measurement vocabulary for WP902. F2 thresholds, capacity, tail latency or goodput claims remain UNKNOWN until measured on exact F2 workloads.
architecture_mapping.offline_behavior: Pinned local METHOD references are the admissible baseline. Live catalog/network availability must not be required for cognition or become authority; stale methods must be lifecycle-invalidatable rather than silently refreshed.

novel_reusable_value: small explicit task-to-reference routing discipline as a policy/example set, not a new core router
performance metric/workload-shape checklist for later WP902 characterization

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: Current WP303-WP306 primitives already provide all useful mechanics; perf-skills adds no measurable gain beyond examples/taxonomy.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: On a fixed F2-native task set, compare identical METHOD records and ContextNeed budgets with versus without the distilled routing/evaluation policy. If assertion quality, token cost or latency does not improve under exact matched conditions, retain only documentation/examples or reject the donor.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: A one-or-two-reference cap can omit counterevidence or a required method and reduce epistemic quality.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Include held-out tasks requiring competing methods/counterevidence and require no regression in assertion correctness or evidence preservation under the bounded method view.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: Static methods become stale and systematically bias later work.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Invalidate or advance source lifecycle generation and prove stale METHOD identities cannot silently survive as current selections or matched-ablation identities.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.counterhypothesis: Paired with-method/without-method scores confound method effect with context length or task/order differences.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Require exact pair/task/generation/metric identity, symmetric workload controls, explicit token/context-cost metrics and order-balanced repetitions before any improvement credit is interpreted beyond association.

e3_candidate_contract.name: F2_METHOD_ROUTING_PAIRED_ABLATION/v1
fixed_inputs: same eligible METHOD memory set and lifecycle identities
e3_candidate_contract.intervention: Enable only the distilled selective method nomination policy while preserving the same canonical METHOD records and existing ContextCompiler.
measurements: selected METHOD item count and cost_units
e3_candidate_contract.acceptance_direction: Candidate is useful only if quality/evidence preservation is noninferior while context cost or latency improves on predeclared metrics; any gain remains WP305-style processing credit candidate, not causal proof or architecture acceptance.
e3_candidate_contract.execution_authority: A later create-only E3 claim is required before execution. No E3 work is executed by this E2 receipt.
